propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the shared rebar logger at module import time, making it process-global and never restored
caplog captures via a handler on the ROOT logger, so rebar.* records with propagate=False cannot reach it, causing subsequent caplog assertions on rebar.* loggers to see zero records
test failures are silent and non-local: the failure appears in an unrelated victim test whose execution order places it after the poisoning call, not in the test that caused it

the failure is intermittent and order-dependent across parallel test runs due to nondeterministic worker assignment in pytest-xdist, making it undetectable by negative assertions that pass vacuously on empty caplog.records

removing propagate=False is safe because uvicorn configures only uvicorn.* loggers and adds no root handler, so propagated rebar.* records find no second sink and the marker-guarded handler prevents duplication
